title: Detecting and identifying the impact of parameter interaction on climate model outputs based on two Perturbed Parameter Ensembles (PPEs)
venue: Micro2Macro: Origins of Climate Change Uncertainty Workshop (US CLIVAR)
processes: cloud microphysics and convection parameter interactions
testbed_rationale: Conference abstract without links or access mechanisms to the underlying ensemble data and code.
pain_points: Parameter interactions can make certain parameters appear deceivingly unimportant if evaluated in isolation
Capturing parameter interactions requires larger ensemble sizes (impact is difficult to capture with <200 members compared to ~500 members)
Outputs respond differently across various spatial and temporal scales, complicating metric choice for calibration
extraction_notes: Conference abstract from the US CLIVAR Micro2Macro 2024 Workshop. Presentation file Yang-Qingyuan.pdf was referenced but not detailed.
